title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode13 A Single Song

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But my music still wasn't able to save anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hurt you, and I couldn't save Yuki. Am I supposed to keep making music even after all this?)
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that's why Yuki was there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alone in that cold, quiet world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay to give up now, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The ground is hard, but it's not cold.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I just close my eyes and stay here...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Will it make the pain go away?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Is that Miku singing? And this song...
It's the one I wrote back then.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You've come back.
Did you come to find her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do you know my song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean...the one I was singing just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That song has existed in this world from the beginning. I was simply singing what I know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My song was here from the beginning?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. It has always been here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I did not realize you had written it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This white, empty world was created from her feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The only thing here was that song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perhaps...that means your song reached her somehow.
But it wasn't enough. I wasn't able to find anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I wasn't able to save Yuki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My song...wasn't enough!
Even if it did reach her, it didn't change anything!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You are in just as much pain as she is...aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perhaps the reason your song is the only thing in this empty world is because you feel the same way she does.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe those shared feelings are why your song was the only thing able to get through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if it wasn't enough...it still reached her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want her to discover her true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She continued to write songs in order to find the real her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No matter how much she suffered or how much she cried, she continued to write.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her true feelings...are that she doesn't want to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, you are the only one who can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can my music help save Yuki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I am sure that if anything is able to help her...it will be your music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then I have to make it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This time, I have to save Yuki for real.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<OWN really is amazing. They must be a genius.
Either that, or they're a professional using an alias.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Wouldn't it be funny if it was just some gloomy, middle-aged guy shut up in his room all the time?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is so stupid... I knew I wouldn't find anything here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When exactly did I lose sight of her...?
